podcast.body: Ron Grainer provided some basic, simple melodies for the "Doctor Who" theme, which Delia Derbyshire then extensively transformed into the final 100% electronic composition. Initially, Grainer was the sole person credited for the piece, despite not recognizing Delia's final version and only having contributed rudimentary elements. Today, the credit is shared equally between them. "Ron Granier una grabe de hecho era una melodía muy sencilla y ella fue la que compuso todo."

srcs.episode: Cómo una mujer inventó la música electrónica ⧸ Delia Derbyshire
